lines.en: label dormwarsfive14:
The following morning...
show monday
$ day = 1
$ totaldays += 1
scene sky
: Okay, girls! Gather round so we can begin the closing ceremony and start the countdown to 363 days from now when we do this all over again!
: You mean unless time has other plans for us and winds up changing the schedule of the universe.
: Right. Because that is a thing that happens.
: Hey. You never know.
scene endofwarfive1
: Well, girls — it’s been another great year of the Dorm Wars, and we couldn’t have done it without you. Because, without you, there would obviously be no one to engage in war with.
: It’d just be me in my room fighting with myself. So basically a regular night. And who wants a regular night every night? Not me. That’s for sure.
: In fact, I don’t want a regular night any night because it’s my personal policy to always try and find something exciting about each and every day!
: Uta. The results?
: What I’m saying here is that it’s important to always stay positive! Especially in these trying times where we’re all becoming acutely aware of what each other are doing behind each other’s backs!
scene endofwarfive2
: We’re what now?
: I just hope that, regardless of the results, no one harbors any ill will against one another and that we can all continue living together as a big ol' dysfunctional girl family! The end.
: Somebody wanna spill the tea or am I too old to sit with y’all now?
: There’s no “tea” at all. I think Uta just didn’t sleep very well.
: Well, it was kind of hard to since we only had one bed and five of us decided to sleep in it together!
scene endofwarfive3
: Honestly, I’m just glad I survived. Tsuneyo is a very strong cuddler.
: You should just be happy you were kept safe.
: I almost died.
: So, can Imani read off the results now or do you want to just keep up Uta-chan’s story time for the rest of the morning?
scene endofwarfive4
: I mean, now that we’ve got the day after the Dorm Wars classified as a national holiday, we don’t really need to take our time, right?
: It’s not a national holiday, just a local one. And we owe it to Miss Imai for getting us the day off, so the least we can let her do is finish the job she loves.
: Fair enough. Please proceed, Imani. We all love you.
scene endofwarfive5
: The final tally after adding everything together is as follows...
: Floor 1: [dormwars5floor1points].
: Floor 2: [dormwars5floor2points].
if dormwars5floor1points > dormwars5floor2points:
scene endofwarfive6
: Which means the winner is the first floor and we all get to listen to Makoto be a sore winner again as the team captain!
: Why brag at all when I knew we were going to win from the start?
: You can brag, Makoto. It’s okay. You guys won fair and-
scene endofwarfive7
: First floor superiority, bitch! You guys seriously thought you had a chance against us?! Are you dense or just stupid?! Just kidding! I already know the answer! It’s both!
: Feel better now that you’ve got that out of your system?
scene endofwarfive8
: Much better. Thank you, Uta. And good work captaining your team — even if it ultimately resulted in inevitable defeat. Which it did because I am better.
: I hope Ayane overthrows you as captain one day. I really do.
: She can’t because she’s too busy being a loser like you.
: Infighting aside, y’all have heard the winner! So go celebrate however you see fit or...do whatever it is you normally do to celebrate victories!
: I’ll be over here trying to stop these two from killing each other.
$ dormwarsfivefloor1win = True
if dormwars5floor2points > dormwars5floor1points:
scene endofwarfive9
: Which means that the second floor is the winner and- the Hell you lookin’ at me like that for, Makoto? Y’all were the ones who lost, not me.
: It’s just that you had the perfect opportunity right then to become a permanent ally of the first floor alliance and you squandered it in favor of-
: The actual winners?
scene endofwarfive10
: That is correct, yes.
: Girls of floor two! On behalf of the entire world and all of Kumon-mi, thank you once again for the passion and dedication it took to crush the competition!
: And while there may not yet be a prize, we shall carry this victory in our hearts! Which is probably good for something! Just not on a monetary level!
scene endofwarfive11
: In the meantime, feel free to go celebrate however you see fit or...do whatever it is you normally do to celebrate victories!
: I’ll be here trying to prevent Makoto from chasing after and subsequently assassinating all of you.
: No one ever lets me have any fun.
$ dormwarsfivefloor2win = True
if dormwars5floor1points == dormwars5floor2points:
scene endofwarfive12
: Which means that we’ve managed to end in a tie!
: Tch. A tie is even worse than losing.
: How is a tie worse than losing?
: Because we don’t have a concrete method of resolving it, which means that this will likely go down as a permanent draw and no one will ever know that my team was better.
: If you guys are better, why didn’t you just win?
scene endofwarfive13
: Probably because some of us weren’t trying hard enough! Cough cough, Miku, cough!
: Did this bitch just say “cough” out loud?
: Three times. Girl wins one court case and she’s suddenly the hottest thing in town.
: Well, surely you won’t mind challenging me to another one to determine a real winner then!
scene endofwarfive14
: Absolutely not. Our poor janitors have been through enough.
: Mngh...
: Why don’t we just call both floors winners instead of saying it’s a tie?
scene endofwarfive15
: DO I LOOK LIKE A JOKE TO YOU, MISS IMAI?!
: Hey! Nobody yells at Imani! She’s too cute to feel the unbridled rage of a sore loser!
: She’d be cuter if she’d call it like it is and say that the first floor is better!
: If you’re better, why didn’t you just win?
scene endofwarfive16
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!
$ dormwarsfivetie = True
scene black
scene endofwarfive17
: Well, Yasu — how did you enjoy your first round of mostly sentient Dorm Wars?
: It was so much quieter than normal! Which you may think is a good thing, but to me is very sad!
: Oh no! Then why are we smiling?!
: Because you get sad whenever I look sad, so I’m just never going to look sad again!
: Please don’t feign your own joy to uphold mine! It puts me in a strange position that I do not like very much!
: Okay! I’ll just go back to being a miserable slug then!
: So it’s true that you are normal now?
scene endofwarfive18
: Yasu was never abnormal, Tsuneyo. She just has some...issues in regard to seeing and hearing things that we are currently battling through the use of medication.
: It’s like when parents tell you to stop spending time with people who are a bad influence on you. I think. I don’t have parents.
scene endofwarfive19
: You may borrow my father. He is definitely alive.
: He would probably die if he met me. My existence is a plague upon this earth.
: Yasu — need I remind you that my mother is your legal guardian now. Which means that, technically, you do have parents.
: Oh, right. Sorry, Touka. That seemed too good to be true, so I imagined you were just playing a prank on me.
: I would never.
: I would. But I’m the funny one, so that sort of thing is to be expected.
scene black
: Maybe you can teach me to be funny! Then next year, I can be in the comedy contest and not have to answer questions about horses!
: At long last...an apprentice. Is this how it feels to have purpose?
: Do you feel an incontrollable light inside of you, begging to be unleashed upon the world?
: Something like that, yes.
: Then yes, that is how that feels.
: Perhaps the two of you should just be roommates instead?...
scene endofwarfive20
: Holy shit...you changed back? Why didn’t you tell me? I would have gone with you.
: Just a...spur of the moment thing. Felt like making a change and stuff.
scene endofwarfive21
: Is it, like...a depression thing? Because I read online that some people get manic before that happens. Are you okay? Do you need anything? What should I-
: It’s not a depression thing, no. I just wanted to, like...get back to what I felt was normal I guess.
: I’ve just had black hair for most of my life and- wait, why were you reading about depression?
: Because I know you have it and I want to be there for you the next time it happens so you don’t hurt yourself anymore.
scene endofwarfive22
: Chika...
: That...huh. That...felt weirdly embarrassing to say for...some reason.
: You really did that for me?
scene endofwarfive23
: Is that weird? It’s probably weird, right? I should back off. I’m getting clingy again.
scene endofwarfive24
: It’s not weird at all...it’s really cute. And I’m really happy you’re looking out for me.
: I have horrible news, though. I kissed your boyfriend.
scene endofwarfive25
: I figured I should tell you before you say anything else nice about me and it becomes harder for me to tell you and I ultimately suppress it for the rest of my life.
: I don’t regret it either.
scene endofwarfive26
: So yeah, I guess we’re rivals now.
: I’ve finally accepted who I have feelings for.
: Are you mad?
: Just...
: A little...shocked...
: You want to hear more about it? Or would that be weird? Cause I’ll tell you. And I haven’t even told Futaba yet.
: You’ll...tell me about...kissing my boyfriend?
: Mhm. Then you can tell me about how you kiss your boyfriend and we can compare strategies. I’m still new to boy-kissing, so I could use the help.
: You’re totally mad. I can see your face getting redder.
: Yeah...I...
: There's...some anger there...
: Just...uh...
: The reason for that...might be...kinda...different from...what you’re expecting?...
scene black
: I...I’ll be right back! Hahah!...Don’t...don’t go anywhere!
: Okaaaay! But please don’t tell anyone else yet! This is still a secret, I think!
scene endofwarfive27
: At long last, I can finally eat in peace. I sure hope no one shows up to ruin it.
scene endofwarfive28
: Hey, look. It’s Maya.
: My god, what have I done?
: So what? Ain’t you two, like...sworn enemies or some shit?
: Star-crossed lovers is more like it.
scene endofwarfive29
: No it’s fucking not! And don’t even think about coming over here to-
scene endofwarfive30
: Hi.
: ...make it even worse.
: Whatcha doing all by yourself? Where’s Sensei?
: Maybe she’s like a lizard and just won’t see me if I don’t move?
: I’m not a lizard, I’m a girl.
: Sounds exactly like what a lizard would say.
: For what it’s worth, I ain’t convinced she’s human either. Thinkin’ more alien than animal, though.
: Well, whatever she is, I would like her to leave. And if you can get her to do that, I am willing to part with a sandwich.
: Noriko, leave. I’m hungry.
: But I don’t want to leave. I’m facing the final boss of friendship right now.
: And failing quite miserably, at that.
: Oh, I know. I’m just trying to learn the fight so I can make it further on subsequent attempts.
: If you haven’t learned it yet, chances are you never-
: Damn, you two are really fucking gay.
scene endofwarfive31
: Right?
: No, we’re not! I hate her no matter how many times she tries to approach me and make me feel bad about that!
: She’s been like this forever. It’s okay, though. I’m used to unwarranted vitriol in response to adoration as a younger sibling.
: The fuck’s there to adore about Ponytail? Seems like she’s just another member of Sensei’s fuckin’ cum-crowd.
: Cum crowd?
: Love squad!
: That’s worse than what I said. Least you can blame sex on impulses. Can’t do that with love.
scene endofwarfive32
: She’s got a point.
: I know! And that just pisses me off even more!
scene black
: What do you have in your picnic basket? Can I look?
: No! Don’t fucking touch that!
: Why? I just want to make sure you’re eating healthy. You’re a growing girl, Maya. It’s important to get all of your nutrients.
: So fucking gay.
: It’s all her! I just wanted to be alone!
scene endofwarfive33
: So, Io! How’d your date with Sensei go? Wanted to ask ya at the strip club yesterday, but you didn’t show up. You got somethin’ against strippers?
: Yes. I think it’s gross and abhorrent for someone to put their body on display like that.
: I disagree. I think it’s liberating.
: And I think the fact that Kirin disagrees with me is further proof that I am justified in holding the correct opinion.
: Either way! Still wanna know what went down. Was kinda hopin’ I’d get chosen for that contest this year, but I ain’t really good at that dating stuff.
scene endofwarfive34
: Me neither. We just hung out inside of a tunnel and discovered a cliff that led to nowhere.
: But I’m pretty sure I can count that as a success since I didn’t annoy him to the point where he felt like he needed to push me off of it.
: A...cliff that led to nowhere?
: Poor Io. The date was so bad that she’s gotta make stuff up about it.
scene endofwarfive35
: I’m serious, though! There’s this giant hole in the city so deep that you can’t even see the bottom of it! I’m pretty sure it’s the one my old school fell into!
: Did you try getting somebody to go stand at the top and yell so you can test that theory?
: No, but I’m working on it.
: I mean...we ain’t got anythin’ goin’ on after this. We’ll come with ya if ya wanna show us your hole, Io.
: Please never speak those words to me again.
: She just means that we’ll help you with your experiment.
: I’m well aware of what she means, but wording is important.
scene endofwarfive36
: Besides, it’s a...secret hole. And I don’t want to show you how to get there from the bottom.
: You don’t believe me, do you?
: Poor Io. The date was so bad that she’s gotta make stuff up about it.
scene black
: Hah...yeah. Knew that was coming.
: Just...
: It was a good date. I think.
: That’s all I can...really say.
if nodokathontwo3 == True:
scene endofwarfive37
: Is something wrong, Ayane?...You’ve been looking at me kind of weird all morning...
: I just...still can’t believe you’d do that to your mom, Sana.
: Nothing happened, though.
: Nothing but the crazy threesome you had with Molly that we all got to watch on TV like one of those late night pay-per-view channels.
scene endofwarfive38
: I’m sad we had to miss yours...Sensei made it sound like he had a lot of fun.
: I’m sure there will be more. You’re welcome to watch the next one. I’ll give you a heads-up if I know it’s coming beforehand.
: Please do.
: Have you at least talked to her at all, Sana?
scene endofwarfive39
: Not yet. But I already know what I’m going to say when we do talk.
: I’ve known for a while, actually. Nodoka’s contest thing just gave me the push I needed to take the first step.
: Toward what exactly? Making your mom feel like shit? Do you have any idea how many people would kill to have a mother who loves them as much as she loves you?
scene endofwarfive40
: I love her too, Ayane. I’m not lying when I say that.
: Then why would you put her through that, Sana? I’m so...so disappointed in you.
: You just don’t get it. We’re different from most families. Something like this won’t hurt us in the long run. It’ll only bring us closer together.
: May I speak as one of those people who does long for the type of mother Sana’s seems to be?
scene endofwarfive41
: I shan’t pretend to understand your situation as I know the relationship one has with their mother can not be easily explained or understood.
: But I ask you — if she were gone tomorrow and the last thing she heard from her daughter was what you recorded on that tape...how would that make you feel?
: My mom’s...not going anywhere, though.
: That’s what I thought too.
scene endofwarfive42
: And Ami...and Ayane.
: Each one of us lost something before we had time to prepare for it. Which is why your actions seem...questionable to us.
: You...did the same thing with Haruka, though. You’re guilty too...
: Haruka is not my mother.
: Well said, Molly.
scene endofwarfive43
: You guys, just...
: You don’t get it.
scene endofwarfive44
: I’ll...see you back at the dorms, I guess.
: Hah...
: Work is going to be very awkward today, isn’t it?
: I can’t believe you guys put that on video.
scene black
: The horny mind is a dangerous one...
: And I suffer its consequences nearly every single day...
scene endofwarfive45
: Well, gang. We did it. We survived another Dorm Wars. And Nodoka didn’t traumatize anybody this time, so I think we can call that a win.
: It’s not my fault our classmates are so easily traumatized. I can’t even fathom how they’d fare in facing what Shiori had to.
: Who?
: Some girl Nodoka’s been talking about since we were kids. I think it’s her imaginary friend.
: She’s real. She’s just somewhere else.
: Your mind?
: My mother’s.
: Now, if you don’t mind, I’d like to get back to my book.
scene endofwarfive46
: And then there were two.
: And then there were two...
: You’ve seemed to be in a better mood lately, Otoha. Is there...any reason for that? Or...
: You seem to be worse. Is there any reason for that? Or...
: Worse?...Really?
: Why do you say that?...
: Oh, no reason.
: Just, if you’re going to make yourself throw up, you should do it in a bathroom the rest of us don’t have access to.
scene endofwarfive47
: You want to talk about it?
: I was sick.
: That’s no good. Maybe we should tell Imani then? I’m sure she knows a doctor.
: Hey...look at me.
: Why? It’s...not like there’s anything you can do about it.
: Didn’t say there was. I know a trick, though.
scene endofwarfive48
: A trick to cure bulimia? That’s a new one.
: A trick to make you feel guilty. Worth a shot since I assume you’ve tried everything else, yeah?
: Hate to break it to you, but I feel plenty guilty as is. What’s the trick?
: Just this. Just keep your eyes on mine.
scene endofwarfive49
: You’re not going to try to steal my heart like you did Rin’s, are you?
: And wipe out an entire dorm room? Nah. I’m not that evil.
: Just a trick I learned from my mom. Whenever I used to lie about stuff, she’d make me look her in the eyes for sixty seconds.
: Never pried or accused me of anything. Just sat there and stared.
: The first ten seconds were always easy. The next ten were awkward and uncomfortable.
: The forty after that, though? I just felt like an idiot. Like she saw through me completely, and it made me think twice about trying to hide or lie about stuff.
: And you think that’ll work for me?
: Probably not.
: But it still feels good to be seen, doesn’t it?
: So long as it’s not me doing the seeing.
: Hm.
scene endofwarfive50
: Hahah...
: I...I think we got to the...awkward part...
: That part’s always the worst.
: Come on. Let’s go get tea or something.
if nodokathontwo3 == True:
scene endofwarfive51
: You like tea, right?
: I’m quite partial to jasmine, actually.
: Two jasmines it is then.
scene endofwarfive52
: Nice weather we’re having, isn’t it?
scene endofwarfive53
: Feels a lot like paradise.
scene endofwarfive54
: What did you just-
scene endofwarfive55
: Why?
: Just felt like you could use a hug.
scene endofwarfive56
: Later, Nodoka! Remember to smile!
scene black
: I will...

scene bedroom_noon
The Dorm Wars have come to an end...
But life moves on.
What should I do now?
jump ch4noonmenu

: I’m quite partial to jasmine, actually.
